description: This file implements a web worker module for handling file storage operations using the File System Access API and IndexedDB, including classes and functions for managing file chunks, metadata, and inter-thread communication.

classes.name: OriginPrivateFileStore
classes.description: A class managing file chunks and metadata storage using IndexedDB and the File System Access API, with methods for reading, writing, deleting, and listing chunks and metadata.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes a new file store with a given name and directory handle.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all files and metadata in the store.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Stores metadata for a given filename.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a given filename.

methods.name: deleteMetadata
methods.description: Deletes metadata for a given filename.

methods.name: writeChunk
methods.description: Writes a data chunk to the directory.

methods.name: deleteChunk
methods.description: Deletes a specific chunk from the directory.

methods.name: readChunk
methods.description: Reads a chunk from the directory.

methods.name: chunkSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a specific chunk.

methods.name: listChunks
methods.description: Lists all chunks with a specific prefix.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all entries in the directory.

methods.name: safeOp
methods.description: Ensures safe concurrent operations on chunks using locks.
